top_insights: Targeted-22 sub-strategy enabled 100% resolution rate vs prior cycles' broader scope. Rolling Mediums+Lows to Cycle 8 (registered as `disposition: rollover`) avoided context dilution and prevented sizing inaccuracy seen in Cycle 4 (350→138 medium drift).

Cross-wave finding linkage (H11 ESLint rule surfaces sites → H18 fixes them) closed the loop within Cycle 7. Demonstrates audit-execute system can chain related findings across waves with traceable evidence.

Sub-agent context budget per work unit ranged 60K-220K tokens. Architectural changes (WU 1.2 resilience wiring, WU 2.1-CommandsCore) consume 2-3× more than surgical fixes (WU 1.4 CLI flags, WU 2.3 dead code). Future planning should reserve XL budget for architectural WUs.

Snapshot test gate failure (Wave 3) was caught and fixed in Attempt 1 (vitest -u). Future sub-agents adding new adapter outputs should proactively run snapshots-update before committing — prevents the gate cycle.

Lint baseline shifted +73 warnings (77→150) due to intentional H11 silent-failure ESLint plugin. Gate strategy on errors (not warnings) absorbed this correctly. Cycle 8 should track silent-failure-rule warnings as a separate metric to measure progress on the 74-site backlog.

Phase 5 PRD batch-approval worked cleanly because no candidates were Vision-Review items. Phase 7 per-proposal consent collected via 3 batched multiSelect questions (4+4+2) was efficient and respected the 'no batch approval' protocol intent (each proposal still got individual yes/no).

Audit-execute commit_sha tracking with follow-on sync commits (vs amend) preserves git history. Each wave now has 2 commits: the wave commit + the registry sync. Acceptable trade for git-safety adherence.
Compliance verification rewrite (C7-C1) from existence-check to import-check is a meaningful structural improvement. Future audits can use the same pattern for other declared-but-unwired modules.

Pre-flight commit of AUDIT-REPORT.md as immutable BASELINE_COMMIT (91682e1) was load-bearing — Phase 0 baseline.json + all wave gates compared against it cleanly. Recommend adding this as an explicit step in AUDIT-EXECUTE.md Phase 0.

Inventory drift caught: CLAUDE.md said 14 pipeline modules, reality 15 (post-Wave 1 retryWithBackoff addition). H10 inventory.ts now prevents this drift in CI. Validates the H10/CL-2 verify-wired pattern.

Validates the fan-out pattern for High-severity batched execution.

Aggressive fan-out preserved file-lock discipline: customization.ts (H1, H2, H43), reviewLoop.ts (H25, H26, H40), mcp-utils.ts (H3, H46), content/index.ts (H4, H7), canonical.ts (H8, H43) each received 2-3 changes in a single cohesive commit via FL sub-agent grouping. Zero merge conflicts recorded.

Scope-exclusion discipline was enforced uniformly: H29 (governance edits outside adapter WU), H40 (production wiring outside reviewLoop scope), H48 (TS field outside content-files scope), H51 (external blocker) all marked PARTIAL with explicit causal-chain-depth=0 for the scope-excluded portion. None of these are false positives; all are correct scope boundaries.

Ship-band transition achieved in one sub-cycle: overall score 39.3 -> 81.4 (+42.1) via focused High-severity batching. This is the largest single-sub-cycle gain since Cycle 5 (97). D15 (Agentic Security & Trust) alone jumped +71.2 via 6 done + 1 partial-complete security findings (H40-H46).

Gate failures in W2B2 were both documentation-currency issues (currency header + count drift), not structural failures. Remediated via one-line edits in a single follow-up commit (3d1929f) without rollback. Pattern suggests currency-header automation could prevent this category entirely in future cycles.

The Cycle 7 CL-3 P10 proposal (pre-audit inventory validation gate) would have caught the CLAUDE.md count drift (Gate 13) pre-wave. Priority for Cycle 8: implement scripts/verify-wired.ts (CL-2 P1 spec) so future waves never ship docs/count mismatches past regression gates.
